body: Closes #4829 ## 🎯 Changes - **Hierarchical Cache Tags:** Added `generateCacheTags(procedurePath, input)` in `@trpc/next/app-dir` to emit all parent router subpaths alongside the procedure-specific input tag: ```ts generateCacheTags('page.home.header', { size: 'medium' }) // [ // 'page', // 'page.home', // 'page.home.header', // 'page.home.header?input={"size":"medium"}' // ] ``` - **Link Integration:** Updated `experimental_nextHttpLink` and `experimental_nextCacheLink` to attach the full hierarchical tags array to Next.js `fetch` options and `unstable_cache`. - **Subrouter Invalidation Typing:** Updated `NextAppDirDecorateRouterRecord` in `types.ts` so `revalidate()` is strongly typed on intermediate subrouters (e.g. `trpc.page.revalidate()`, `trpc.page.home.revalidate()`). - **Falsy Input Preservation:** Fixed `generateCacheTag` to check `input !== undefined` so falsy inputs like `0` or `false` aren't dropped. ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Followed the [Contributing guide](https://github.com/trpc/trpc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). - [x] Added unit and integration tests for tag generation and subrouter revalidation (`packages/next/src/app-dir/cacheTags.test.ts`). - [x] Verified typechecking (`tsc --noEmit`), linting (`eslint`), and formatting (`prettier`). --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Cache entries now receive tags for each level of a procedure path, supporting more targeted cache revalidation. * Nested routers can trigger revalidation and receive a result indicating whether it succeeded. * **Bug Fixes** * Cache tags now include defined inputs such as `0` and `false`, helping ensure the correct entries are revalidated. * Revalidation failures now return an error message instead of leaving the outcome unreported.
